audience: Owners of established Sydney small-to-medium B2B and professional-service businesses
problem: Lead generation is split across creative, ads, forms, follow-up and reporting, leaving the owner to repair the handoffs.
single_message: A fully managed service should operate the whole repeatable lead path while the owner keeps control of the offer and sales decisions.
supporting_points: Connect the offer, creative, advertising, capture, follow-up and reporting
Keep human approval over positioning, audience, qualification and sales
Report spend and lead outcomes without inventing proof
angle: One accountable service connects campaign production to lead capture, follow-up and reporting without removing owner judgement.
headline_options: What should a fully managed lead generation service include?
One accountable path from attention to enquiry
selected_headline: What should a fully managed lead generation service include?
caption_hook_options: Most lead-generation offers stop at the ad

selected_hook: Most lead-generation offers stop at the ad
caption_cta: Read the article and request a short call
visual_concept: A coastal lighthouse casts one warm beam across the water and guides three small boats towards harbour.
image_generation_prompt: Fresh photorealistic Australian coastal lighthouse at dawn with one warm beam guiding three modest boats toward harbour. Portrait editorial composition, earthy Run Lighter palette, no text, no logo, no office, no technology effects.
search_question: What should a fully managed lead generation service include?
direct_answer: A fully managed lead generation service should connect the offer, creative, advertising, capture, follow-up and reporting as one accountable system, while the owner keeps control of positioning and sales decisions.
promotion_hypothesis: A direct managed-service offer paired with a distinctive lighthouse metaphor should qualify owner interest better than broad automation education.
risk_notes: Do not guarantee lead volume, quality, bookings or revenue
Do not treat form submission as qualification
Keep owner approval and sales judgement explicit
Never change the Meta budget automatically
